ui.settings.convert.title: PDF font (Markdown → PDF)
ui.settings.convert.desc: Converting Markdown to PDF needs a font that can typeset Chinese. Pick one here; leave empty to auto-select (TrueType is preferred because its subset is much smaller).
ui.settings.convert.cff_hint: CFF outlines, PDF will be somewhat larger
ui.settings.convert.missing_title: No usable CJK font found: conversions containing Chinese will fail instead of producing a page full of question marks
ui.settings.convert.missing_hint: Drop any .ttf / .ttc / .otf CJK font into {dir} and press "Rescan", or type the absolute path of a font file below.
ui.settings.convert.font_hint: The file is verified when you save: it must contain Chinese glyphs. Relative paths resolve against the program root.
